what: DERIVATION, independent attempt 2 of 2: Do the species agree about the field's own equations?. Block 54's walk H = sum_a sigma_a S_a, S_a = (T_a - T_a^dagger)/(2i), C_a = (T_a + T_a^dagger)/2, the qubit as coin; with a rate field w = phi^2 the generator is phi H phi. Block 63: pi_j = Re psi^dagger S_j psi is conserved with the bond current J_a^j(x -> x+e_a) = (1/2) Re[psi^dagger(x+e_a) sigma_a (S_j psi)(x) + (S_j psi)^dagger(x+e_a) sigma_a psi(x)]; a relabelling G_xi = (1/2) sum_j {xi_j, S_j} gives i[H, G_xi] = sum sigma_a (1/2){C_a[d_a xi_j], S_j} (second-neighbour reach), with C_a[v] the symmetric hop weighted by the bond function v. Block 64: bond strains B_a^j coupled that way; field energies built from plaquette curls; counted per local tick and blind to the coin's axes => the curvature member, beta = 1. Block 66: for F = int e^u D(e) the identity d_a J_b^a = (energy density) d_b u (the content's stress gradient equals its weight), which is clause B's force law; on the lattice i[H_w, G_xi] = phi (i[H, G_xi]) phi - (Lambda_xi H phi + phi H Lambda_xi), Lambda_xi = (1/2) sum {xi_j, C_j[d_j phi]}, force density f_j = Re[(C_j[d_j phi] psi)^dagger H phi psi + psi^dagger C_j[d_j phi] H phi psi], equal to (energy density) d_j u at leading order with a cos k factor. Block 60 (curvature member, bodies at rest, exact): chi = sqrt(length) = 1 + sum Q_i g_i, N = w chi = 1 - sum P_i g_i, Q_i chi_i = m_i/(8K), P_i = Q_i w_i; far fields: lengths 2Q, rates P + Q. Block 68: the walk has EIGHT species (zeros at every k_a in {0, pi}; D = diag((-1)^{n_a})); the nearest-neighbour frame shows them D g D; the second-neighbour strain coupling shows (1 + B D)^T (1 + B D) (a stretch is a squeeze for reflected species). Block 69: P_j = S_j C_j (symbol (1/2) sin 2k) is every species' own wave number and is conserved; the relabelling generated with it has reach three, an exactly conserved response K_a^j (J with P_j for S_j), and shows every species (1 + B)^T (1 + B). Block 70 (exact, for VARYING fields): U_n = (-1)^{n.x}, s_n = det D_n, rho_n = s_n D_n, R_n the coin's half turn for rho_n, V_n = R_n U_n: V_n H V_n = s_n H in any rate field; frame E -> rho E rho; twist theta -> rho theta; reach-two strain B -> B D (one side only); reach-three strain unchanged; Theta = sigma_2 x conjugation commutes with all five generators; A_n = Theta V_n (n odd) carries solutions to solutions in the same fields with the energy reversed: sixteen branches = two classes of eight exact copies under rates and reach-three strains, mirror images of each other; U_(111) reverses the energy of everything that hops an odd number of steps; the reach-two strain alone breaks it (tr H^3 = -735/8192 for an executed field). Block 71: amplitudes of negative energy are exact twins as test bodies and exact opposites as sources (e_x -> -e_x; block 55's ledger carries the sign): positive pairs attract, negative pairs repel, a mixed pair chases with matched pulls; curvature member, one body of either sign: w_0 = (1 + g_0 m/(2K))^(-1/2); a negative body at rest has a static field iff m > -2K/g_0 (zero mode g of -Delta + Q/chi at the bound; second root has a negative rate); many bodies: positive static rates iff -Delta + Q/chi (walls held) is positive definite; no rule of finite reach commuting with translations keeps exactly the positive energies. Block 72: block 66's requirement on the content (stress gradient = weight, from a per-tick relabelling-blind field energy) by species: exact f_j[V_n psi] = s_n D_j f_j[psi] (reach two), fP_j[V_n psi] = s_n fP_j[psi] (reach three, fP built from the two-step hop (1/2) C2_j[d2_j phi]), e[V_n psi] = s_n e[psi]; at leading order the requirement holds for all eight species under reach three and FAILS with the opposite sign for species reflected along the gradient under reach two. Block 73: the conserved translation-invariant operators of finite reach are a(k) + c(k) H; no scalar momentum of reach <= 1 is every species' own wave number; at reach <= 2 the only covariant one is (1/2) sin 2k_j (six second-order functions sin k_b sin k_c removed by the proper rotations); the part along the walk allowed is gamma sin k_j H, a second-order scalar. Block 74: the three responses under the maps: the frame's site stress Theta_a^j -> s_n D_a D_j Theta_a^j, the reach-two bond current J_a^j -> s_n D_j J_a^j, the reach-three bond current K_a^j -> s_n K_a^j; they agree at leading order for the first species, and K is every species' own stress: the frame serves species (000) and (111) and has the wrong sign in shear for the other six; reach two serves (000) only; reach three all eight. Block 75: on a closed lattice sum_z (Delta f)_z/f_z = sum_bonds (f_x - f_y)^2/(f_x f_y) for positive f; curvature member: never at rest on a closed lattice, whatever the signs of bodies at rest; simplest member (block 56): rest iff sum m > 0 > sum m w with the ledger exactly zero (both signs needed); a pair iff 1/|m_B| - 1/m_A = gamma (G_0 - G_d).
